864-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1651-4772-6753-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-4772-6753-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

856-4321-5632-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5632-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

643-4050-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-4050-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1893-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-5256.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2178-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
728-2178-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4247-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4247-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1978-4045-5793-7008.description:
Activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Ur-Golem's Eye which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

440-5796-7426-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-5796-7426-7743.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
440-5796-7426-7743.description:
Draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Heroic Feast trigger.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

206-215-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
206-215-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2757-5864-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats - one of which doesn't have summoning sickness.
2757-5864-7109.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat, untapping the basic land.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 two additional times.
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5571-6798-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3581-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3581-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1659-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1659-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5231-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-1744.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating three token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating three times that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-2099-2793-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1350-2499-3390-3518-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1850-4482-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4482-5412.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

38-2420-2744.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-2744.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Scuzzback Marauders enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

56-5686-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

64-372-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

277-5226-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-5226-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

116-1242-1323-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Kiora's Follower each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
116-1242-1323-3143.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1744-3700-4092.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Sanctum Prelate.
As the token Sanctum Prelates enter the battlefield, choose the following numbers: 0, 1, 2, 3, and any other number.
Cast Gaddock Teeg by paying {G}{W}.
Because of Gaddock Teeg and the Sanctum Prelate tokens, noncreature spells cannot be cast.

2034-4681-4812-5237.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you controlled has left the battlefield this turn.
2034-4681-4812-5237.description:
Cast Renegade Rallier by paying {1}{G}{W}.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Renegade Rallier trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3818-4214-5189.notablePrerequisites: Sengir has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3818-4214-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Sengir's first ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Repeat.

1030-1872-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1872-2178.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Othelm triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
